tools.name: render_infographic
tools.description: Render GraphMake Script into an infographic image (PNG or SVG). GraphMake Script is a short line-based format, e.g. `title "..."`, `kpi "Label" "Value" icon=users`, `bar_chart "T" { Jan: 42\n Feb: 68 }`, `timeline { 2024: "Event" "detail" }`, `style bold` and `row { ... }` for side-by-side blocks; the full syntax is in the GraphMake Script reference. Returns the image and a link that opens it in the GraphMake editor for hand-editing and export. Script errors come back with the line number.

format.description: png (default) returns an image; svg returns the SVG markup as text, ready to save to a file.

tools.name: graphmake_script_reference
tools.description: The full GraphMake Script language reference: every widget, chart, theme, style, size and syntax rule, with examples.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List GraphMake's designed infographic templates: id, name, category, size and what each is for. An optional query such as "sales report", "timeline", "resume" or "comparison" ranks the best matches first; an optional category filters the list.

query.description: Optional words describing the infographic, e.g. "sales report".

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Read one template: its size, description and every editable text and number, as field keys with their current values (e.g. "w0.text": "Annual Report 2026", "w5.datasets.0.values": [820, 1050]). The same keys change the template when it is rendered. With preview set to true, the template's preview image is included.

preview.description: Also return the template preview image (default false).

tools.name: render_template
tools.description: Render a template filled with new content. "changes" maps the template's field keys to new values, e.g. {"w0.text": "Q3 Sales Review", "w5.labels": ["Jul","Aug","Sep"], "w5.datasets.0.values": [42, 51, 63]}. Fields not included keep the template's sample content. Replacing a whole list (e.g. "w7.values": [{"label": "A", "value": 40}, ...]) changes how many items it has; each item keeps the colours of the item it replaces. Returns the image and a link that opens the filled template in the GraphMake editor.

changes.description: Field key -> new value, e.g. {"w0.text": "Q3 Sales Review"}.

format.description: png (default) returns an image; svg returns the SVG markup as text.

tools.name: open_in_editor
tools.description: Build a GraphMake editor URL that opens with the script already rendered on an editable canvas, where the infographic can be restyled by hand and exported as PNG, SVG or PDF.
